text: {"assertions":["A conflict loop bug in mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift was fixed where two clients would rewrite each other on every sync pass.","The root cause of the sync conflict loop was a cache entry that was never invalidated on write operations.","The fix involved invalidating the cache entry inside the write transaction, implemented in PR #2111 on branch fix/conflict-loop-1.","The conflict loop bug only appeared when traffic traveled through the corporate proxy.","The sync conflict bug could be reproduced by editing the same note on two devices while offline.","The fix to the sync conflict loop resulted in a 93% improvement in cold start performance, reducing it to 658 milliseconds.","The mobile sync conflict fix is covered by tests in mobile/ios/SyncEngineTests.swift."]}
